description: This file contains unit tests for the IPC (Inter-Process Communication) system in the Rialto project, utilizing Google Test framework. It tests various request and event handling scenarios between client and server stubs, including single and multiple variable requests, responses, event reception, timeout handling, and no-reply requests.

classes.name: RialtoIpcTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for setting up IPC tests with mock modules and client/server stubs.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes mock objects, server and client stubs, and connects the client.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Disconnects and resets the client and server stubs, and resets mock objects.
